fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia's SFDA introduced 20-business-day process for rare disease drug (NADR) classification and is accelerating regulatory improvements by advancing five initiatives for clinical trial progression.
fields.summary_ko.1: Singapore's Health Sciences Authority and SFDA signed MOU on September 14 to expand regulatory cooperation and information exchange, while Lifera strengthened CDMO capabilities through MOUs with Pfizer, Sanofi, and MSD.
